seed: I'm a music journalist with a focus on Australian rock music, eager to analyze the development of Baby Animals' sound in their follow-up to their successful debut album.

persona.name: Tom Bennett
persona.demographics: Urban (Melbourne, Australia); Anglo-Australian; raised in Geelong, Victoria; currently lives in Fitzroy, Melbourne
persona.profession: Senior Music Journalist and Features Writer — focuses on Australian rock music
persona.education: B.A. in Journalism, RMIT University; M.A. in Musicology, University of Melbourne; occasional guest lecturer in music journalism
persona.brief_background: Tom writes deep-dive features and reviews that combine close musical analysis with cultural context; he spends nights at live gigs and afternoons cutting through press releases to get musicians to open up. He is especially interested in tracing how bands evolve from a raw breakthrough record to more mature follow-ups, and he is currently researching the evolution of Baby Animals' sound after their breakthrough debut.
persona.interests_lifestyle: attending live gigs and small-venue shows, collecting vinyl and bootlegs, interviewing musicians, long-form writing and podcasting about music, playing electric guitar in a weekend cover band, researching music archives, festival-hopping, local café culture, social media promotion of long-form features
